verdict.rationale: Fern ships a CLI and a hosted docs platform, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no telemetry opt-out, environment flag, or tracking-disable setting. The analytics features it does mention (llms.txt traffic analytics, reader activity) are adjacent tracking capabilities, not opt-out controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
